description: Minimum safe versions for the three packages the npm-audit-scanner-v1 run flagged against services/gateway/package.json. This file is the machine-readable floor; cve-version-guard.test.ts pins it and evaluateDependencySafety() (services/gateway/src/lib/dependency-safety-guard.ts) validates a manifest against it — so the floors survive future dependency churn instead of living only in a one-off PR.

requirements.reason: Transitive (via the @google-cloud/* and firebase-admin grpc clients). Only a root-level overrides pin can raise it — a direct dependency bump would not reach the transitive copy.
Direct dependency. The vulnerable line is the 0.x series; the safe floor is a 1.x release.
Direct dependency. 8.2.1 is the affected release; 8.2.2 carries the fix.

pending_remediation.reason: services/gateway/package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml and package-lock.json are outside the Dev Autopilot executor's allow_scope (package.json is only reachable through the npm-audit scanner override in dev-autopilot-safety.ts:applyScannerOverrides, which the runner's own scope check does not apply). Apply the three requirements above to services/gateway/package.json by hand — bump @modelcontextprotocol/sdk to ^1.24.0, bump express-rate-limit to ^8.2.2, add a root-level "overrides": { "@grpc/grpc-js": ">=1.14.4" } block — regenerate the lock file with pnpm install, then delete this pending_remediation block: cve-version-guard.test.ts fails until it is removed, which is what keeps this hand-off from silently rotting.
